scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical Test6.6 Editor; reviewed case and framework.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical Test6.6 Editor; reviewed case and framework.

scenarios.prerequisites: Idle graphical Test6.6 Editor; reviewed case and declared framework.
